name: ac-qualitative-synthesis
description: Bringing qualitative studies together without destroying what makes them qualitative: choosing the approach, meta-aggregation and its findings-categories-syntheses levels, thematic synthesis and its descriptive then analytical themes, meta-ethnography and translations, refutational synthesis that treats disagreement as data, critical appraisal with a named checklist, CERQual confidence rating, and the written qualitative record. It explains how findings are produced from findings; it never reduces themes to counts. Use when asking "qualitative synthesis", "thematic synthesis", "meta-ethnography", "meta-aggregation", "line by line coding", "third order constructs", "ENTREQ", "CASP qualitative checklist", "satur", "refutational synthesis", "qualitative evidence". Not for the review's conduct machinery (ac-systematic-review-conduct), not for statistical pooling of quantitative studies (ac-meta-analysis-and-synthesis), not for writing the report (ac-academic-writing).
